target_customer: Consumers and possibly clinicians interested in brain health and cognitive awareness
problem: People lacked simple ways to measure and understand their brain health. SpringWit described its offer only as brain health and awareness.

founders.name: Marc Flajolet
founders.background_notes: The YC page names only Marc Flajolet with no biography. A search for his education found nothing reliable.

competitors.name: Lumosity
competitors.traction_then: Market leading brain game brand, per a 2014 APA article

competitors.name: Posit Science (BrainHQ)
competitors.what: Brain training platform moved online in April 2014

technical_complexity.rationale: Brain health measurement implies cognitive testing and some science, but no source describes the product.

defensibility.rationale: No source shows proprietary data or clinical validation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes any incumbent response.

market_need_then: In 2014 brain training was a visible consumer category, but a 2014 open letter from scientists questioned its evidence, per search coverage of the APA and Neurologica pieces.

branding.domain_note: Used springwit.com per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no coverage of SpringWit itself.

outcome_analysis: SpringWit was a single founder brain health company in YC Summer 2014 that is now inactive. No coverage, funding amount, shutdown date or cause is public, so the cause of failure is not public and failure factors are empty.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503 in this session. The seed round with Y Combinator appears only in a Crunchbase listing seen in search results, without an amount, and rests on one database. The Lumosity source is dated about four months after the batch start. The cause of shutdown is not public.
